conventions.projector: P is the rank4 orthogonal projector onto an arbitrary complex first-order AC subspace of spin4.
conventions.casimirMap: Phi(A)=sum_a J_a A J_a, with eigenvalue20-L(L+1)/2 on tensor rankL.
conventions.pureMultipoles: a_L=sum_M |Tr(rho T_LM)|^2 for Hilbert-Schmidt-orthonormal spin8 tensors; a_L>=0.
conventions.twoCopyProbabilities: p_J=||Pi_J(q tensor q)||^2, J=0,2,...,16, sum_J p_J=1.

scope: No reality, spatial symmetry, support pattern or group ansatz is imposed on the excluded subspace.

generalEvenQubitConsequence.saturationLift: If k=N/2 then P=N I/[2(N+1)]+X with X supported only at tensor rankN. The normalized time-reversed vectorization of X is pure2N-qubit(N-1)-AC.
generalEvenQubitConsequence.largeNContradiction: For evenN>=10, its tensor-error Gram matrix through rankN/2-1 has dimension(N/2)^2>2N+1. ForN8 use the displayed rational recoupling identity.
